params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'
$ws=$false; try { Test-WSMan -ComputerName heaven2 -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; $ws=$true } catch {}
$ping = Test-Connection -ComputerName heaven2 -Count 1 -Quiet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$admin = Test-Path '\\heaven2\c$'
$users = Test-Path '\\heaven2\Users'
[pscustomobject]@{host=$env:COMPUTERNAME; ping=$ping; winrm=$ws; admin_share=$admin; users_share=$users} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
